plan.understanding: Convert the three-hole mounting pattern on the back (+Y, y=0) of the finned Cyclops Plus heatsink body s1 into the four-hole rectangular pattern shown on body s0, the Cyclops Aqua Block reference.

subtasks.goal: On body s1, replace the three-point mounting pattern opening through back face #466 (y=0, normal [0,1,0], current inner-loop edges [1350,1351,1346]) with four matching threaded mounting holes on the measured Y axis: retain the upper holes centered at approximately [35.5,0,20.0] and [44.5,0,20.0], remove and heal the lower-center hole centered at [40.0,0,10.0] (edge_idx 1346), and add equivalent holes centered at [35.5,0,10.0] and [44.5,0,10.0]. Match the existing mounting-hole family, including the d=3.4 mm mouths and associated red d=3.086 mm internal cylindrical/thread geometry, depth, and opening direction. Use the four openings on reference body s0 face #145, edges [497,498,499,500], centered at x=-44.5/-35.5 and z=5.5/15.5, as the 9.0 mm by 10.0 mm pattern authority. Print the final four mouth centers and verify that face #466 has four openings at the stated coordinates, with no opening remaining at [40.0,0,10.0]; correct any misplaced instance in the same attempt.
